name: magnetic-bento
title: Magnetic bento
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Bento grid with one shared highlight that glides and stretches between cards.

files.content: "use client" import type { ReactNode } from "react" import { ArrowRight, Compass, Droplets, Images, Package, Store, Wrench } from "lucide-react" import { MagneticBento, MagneticBentoCta, MagneticBentoDescription, MagneticBentoIcon, MagneticBentoIndex, MagneticBentoItem, MagneticBentoTitle, type MagneticBentoAccent, type MagneticBentoSpan, } from "@/components/ui/magnetic-bento" type Card = { value: string index: string title: string description: string cta: string accent: MagneticBentoAccent span: MagneticBentoSpan icon: ReactNode } const cards: Card[] = [ { value: "horno", index: "01", title: "Horno norte", description: "Calendario compartido para las quemas de la semana.", cta: "Ver agenda", accent: "chart-1", span: { col: 2, row: 2 }, icon: , }, { value: "esmalte", index: "02", title: "Bitácora de esmalte", description: "Pruebas y recetas que salieron del taller.", cta: "Abrir notas", accent: "chart-2", span: { col: 1, row: 1 }, icon: , }, { value: "empaque", index: "03", title: "Carril de empaque", description: "Cajas listas y el orden de salida.", cta: "Revisar cajas", accent: "chart-3", span: { col: 1, row: 2 }, icon: , }, { value: "muro", index: "04", title: "Muro de galería", description: "Piezas que están en exhibición ahora.", cta: "Recorrer", accent: "chart-4", span: { col: 1, row: 1 }, icon: , }, { value: "mayoreo", index: "05", title: "Mesa de mayoreo", description: "Pedidos de tienda y fechas de entrega.", cta: "Ver pedidos", accent: "chart-5", span: { col: 3, row: 1 }, icon: , }, { value: "reparacion", index: "06", title: "Estante de reparación", description: "Piezas que vuelven al banco.", cta: "Atender", accent: "primary", span: { col: 1, row: 1 }, icon: , }, ] /** Six studio cards. Document order places the 2×2, the side column, and the wide row. */ export function MagneticBentoGrid({ className, label = "Taller" }: { className?: string; label?: string }) { return ( {cards.map((card) => ( {card.icon} {card.index} {card.title} {card.description} event.preventDefault()}> {card.cta} ))} ) }

api.name: active / defaultActive / onActiveChange
api.description: The lit card. Omit active for internal state. null hides the highlight.

api.name: persist
api.description: Keep the last card lit when the pointer leaves. Default true.

api.name: roving
api.description: Arrow keys move the highlight. Home and End jump to the ends. Default true.

api.name: MagneticBentoItem value
api.description: Stable id for the card. Required.

api.name: span
api.description: Column and row span. Columns clamp to 1 on a narrow container, 2 from 36rem, and the requested span from 56rem.

api.name: accent
api.description: Host chart or primary token for the icon, the call to action, and the highlight mix.

api.name: MagneticBentoCta asChild
api.description: Render a router link or other element instead of an anchor.

api.name: className / classNames
api.description: Root class and slot classes for the grid, indicator, item, icon, index, title, description, and cta.

docs: The active card sets anchor-name. The indicator uses position-anchor and inset: anchor(inside), and transitions inset for about 450ms with a slight overshoot. That path works in Chromium since mid-2024, Safari since September 2025, and Firefox 147 (January 2026). When CSS.supports('anchor-name: --x') is false, ResizeObserver and getBoundingClientRect place the same indicator. Each grid uses its own anchor name. With reduced motion the indicator moves without the stretch, and the call to action fades in without a slide. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The anchor-positioning idea is from jh3yy: https://x.com/jh3yy/status/2105823926978814273. This is an independent implementation.
